SETTINGS_DESC: Keeps the audio output open so HDMI receivers, SPDIF decoders and USB DACs do not lose lock, click or cut the start of a track after a pause.
KEEPALIVE_ENABLED_DESC: While no music plays, inaudible noise is written to the output so the device never closes. Music is passed through unchanged. There is no extra volume control. Works with HDMI, SPDIF and USB DACs.
